summary: A local-first Deployigo platform with a public customer web app, backend API, and separate admin panel for authenticated project workspaces, source uploads/connections, technology detection, and controlled deployment orchestration. Remote deployment and DNS/SSL integrations are intentionally deferred from the MVP.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace is empty and contains no existing application manifests or deployment configuration.

questions.question: Which programming language for Deployigo Web App?
questions.rationale: The project is new and benefits from shared typed contracts across the web app and API.

questions.question: Which frontend framework for Deployigo Web App?

options.label: React + Vite
options.description: React SPA with Vite and fast local development

questions.rationale: React with Vite is a pragmatic choice for a typed local-first console and public authentication flows.

questions.question: Describe the features or screens for Deployigo Web App.
questions.recommendedChoice: Public homepage, login/signup, session-aware project workspace dashboard, ZIP upload, GitHub connection, technology detection results, deployment request status, and staging URL display.
questions.answer: Public homepage, login/signup, session-aware project workspace dashboard, ZIP upload, GitHub connection, technology detection results, deployment request status, and staging URL display.
questions.rationale: Distilled from the requested MVP customer workflow.

questions.question: Which programming language for Deployigo Backend API?
questions.rationale: A shared TypeScript contract between the React clients and API keeps the MVP compact and testable.

questions.question: Which backend framework for Deployigo Backend API?
questions.rationale: Fastify provides low-overhead HTTP handling and strong request validation for a focused API.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Deployigo Backend API.
questions.recommendedChoice: Health checks; signup/login/logout; 8-hour session timeout with one active device per user; projects and workspaces; ZIP upload; GitHub repository connection; source metadata and PHP-first technology detection; deployment request records; isolated-runtime deployment adapter stub; staging URL generation; audit logging and admin endpoints.
questions.answer: Health checks; signup/login/logout; 8-hour session timeout with one active device per user; projects and workspaces; ZIP upload; GitHub repository connection; source metadata and PHP-first technology detection; deployment request records; isolated-runtime deployment adapter stub; staging URL generation; audit logging and admin endpoints.
questions.rationale: Distilled from the requested MVP and its explicit security/deployment boundaries.

questions.question: Which programming language for Deployigo Admin Panel?
questions.rationale: The admin panel shares API types and authentication behavior with the customer web app.

questions.question: Which frontend framework for Deployigo Admin Panel?
questions.rationale: A shared React toolchain reduces duplicated frontend setup while keeping the admin surface separately deployable.

questions.question: Describe the features or screens for Deployigo Admin Panel.
questions.recommendedChoice: Admin login, user and active-session overview, project/deployment queue, deployment logs and status, technology detection review, runtime health, and audit events.
questions.answer: Admin login, user and active-session overview, project/deployment queue, deployment logs and status, technology detection review, runtime health, and audit events.
questions.rationale: Distilled from the requested separate admin panel and deployment management needs.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist data or use storage, queues, or caches

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store uploaded ZIP archives and source artifacts

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Primary relational database for users, projects, sessions, and deployments

questions.rationale: PostgreSQL stores management data; uploaded ZIP/source artifacts require Blob Storage or a local Blob-compatible emulator.

questions.question: Does this app need user login?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Add user sign-in and authenticated API access

options.label: No
options.description: No user sign-in or authenticated API access

questions.rationale: The MVP explicitly requires signup/login, private project workspaces, and admin access.
